title: Write handlers: reject invalid input and preserve the correction
goal: Exercise the existing ПередЗаписью through real object writes, correct two defects and reread the accepted request.
prerequisites: onec.p4; P1–P3; explicit contracts, types, collections and failure handling.
outcomes: Locate an object handler and distinguish it from a form handler.
Check missing customer and 1441 minutes before an accepted write.
Retain the other input fields when correcting an error.
sections: Defaults help create an object but do not validate later writing. Another form, exchange or programmatic call can change values. Separate convenient filling from mandatory validation. Customer, service and duration rules belong at a reliable write boundary; UI explains them to people.

ПередЗаписью belongs to the ЗаявкаУслуги object module. It checks customer, service, status and the 0..1440 range, setting Отказ. The function exercises this rule with actual object writes. This alone does not establish a universal access policy: permissions, external sources and alternate mutation paths require separate analysis.

BeforeWrite receivesCancel and document-writing parameters. It can enforce invariants and reject the operation. Do not reference a particular form’s controls: objects can be written without that form. Messages should identify invalid fields, but a missing message does not make a canceled write successful.

First attempt a write with no customer; next supply the customer but use 1441 minutes. Both refusals should leave the new document reference empty. Correct to 30, write the same object and reread customer/service/duration. Preserving input lets the learner fix one field instead of rebuilding the entire form.

Repeated writing must not add another bonus document or accumulate customer minutes without an accounting rule. Side effects need idempotency and transactional linkage. Begin with input validation and add effects only under explicit requirements. Write identical data twice and compare every affected dataset.

Do not define a second ПередЗаписью or nest it inside application startup. Inspect and preserve the existing handler, combining changes only in a copy. Place the exported experiment function in a server common module; startup contains only the call. Do not disable validation to obtain a passing message.
Bypassing UI is a required control

Attempt invalid programmatic writing in a copy. If the form rejects−1 but the object accepts it, the rule protects one route only. Compare document count and prior values. Follow with a valid write. Exchange-loading behavior needs an explicit policy rather than universally disabling invariants.

The negative control substitutes valid 1440 for invalid 1441. It compiles, but the expected-refusal assertion no longer passes. This demonstrates discrimination across the boundary, not exhaustive coverage of all values or UI messages. Add 0, 1440, a negative value and empty references to your own scenario table.
